to: you for the `{code}` form (the shutdown code goes to everyone). The bare-string form goes to clients and observers near a point (`xy_emit`)

variants.name: Object
variants.when: UI timers for one character, and the shutdown countdown. Also a hitchhiker in `player` at login.

variants.name: Bare string
variants.when: Visual effects at a point: `throw` of an item, `temporalsurge`, the end of a duel. The string is the code.

confirm.note: Sent with `xy_emit` to the clients near the point.

EvalCode.summary: An `eval` payload in object form: the code of the official client to run.

fields.name: code
fields.description: A call of a function of the official client, for example `pot_timeout(4000)`, `pvp_timeout(3600)`, `skill_timeout('ethereal',120)`, `ui_move(x,y)`, `call_code_function('trigger_event','shutdown',{seconds:N})`.

senders.what: `complete_attack`, a PvP hit: `pvp_timeout(3600)` to the target, and `pvp_timeout(3600,1)` to the attacker (`mode.dpvpblock` is 1, node/server.js:272).
Login (`init_player`): a hitchhiker `["eval", {code: "skill_timeout('<skill>',<ms>)"}]` for each class skill whose cooldown is not over.
`throw` of `confetti`, `firecrackers`, `whiteegg` or `smoke`: a bare string near the target point.
`temporalsurge`: `assassin_smoke(x,y,'icecrack');` near each respawn point that it speeds up.
The end of a duel: `confetti_shower(get_player('<name>'),2)` near each winner.
